plans.title: Basic
plans.subTitle: The Daily Energy Boost
plans.tagline: Budget-friendly daily TV and fresh farm fuel.

features.modalDescription: Get a curated daily basket containing three fresh, ready-to-eat seasonal fruits like apples, bananas, and oranges.
All produce is harvested daily and sourced directly from regional partner farms to support local agriculture.
Fresh fruit baskets are dropped at your doorstep every single morning before 7:00 AM, rain or shine.
Access over 150 television channels focusing on local news, regional soap operas, and state broadcasts.
Enjoy crisp everyday viewing quality with our standard 1080i high-definition satellite feed transmissions.
Watch all government-mandated and free-to-air local live sporting matches without any extra network fees.
Includes a durable, easy-to-use digital standard satellite receiver box with standard installation included.
Download our companion mobile application to stream live television channels on one smartphone device.

plans.title: Standard
plans.subTitle: The Family Fitness Pack
plans.tagline: Value-packed nutrition and entertainment for families.

features.modalDescription: An upgraded daily basket containing five assorted lifestyle fruits plus an exciting rotating surprise fruit option weekly.
All fruits undergo a specialized medical-grade sonic ozone wash to fully remove surface pesticides and bacteria safely.
Baskets are transported in custom insulated cold-chain vehicles to keep delicate fruits crisp until physical drop-off.
Expands your viewing library to 350 channels, adding complete kids' cartoon networks, music, and dedicated premium movie screens.
Upgrade to absolute crystal clear 1080p presentation alongside immersive 5.1 Dolby Digital surround sound support.
Never miss a match with full access to premium domestic and international live cricket tournament sports networks.
Receive an intelligent media box that allows users to instantly pause, rewind, or schedule record live television.
Unlocks bundled digital access to popular regional streaming video-on-demand platforms directly through your accounts.

plans.title: Premium
plans.subTitle: The Exotic Wellness Club
plans.tagline: Elite luxury pairing premium entertainment with elite nutrition.

features.modalDescription: Indulge in imported ultra-premium organic berries, dragon fruits, avocados, paired with artisanal honey and dry nut selections.
Sourced entirely from certified organic luxury estates and international partners adhering to strict fair-trade cultivation standards.
Manage deliveries on the go. Temporarily halt your fruit deliveries via our smart app whenever you travel away.
Unrestricted tier access to every single station available, spanning premium global news, niche lifestyle channels, and international programs.
Experience ultra-high-definition resolution depth up to 2160p for unbelievable cinema-grade screen color fidelity and sharpness.
Unlocks every single global sporting stream, including international soccer leagues, grand slams, motorsports, and combat fighting events.
An elite hybrid box featuring built-in Wi-Fi, Chromecast capabilities, Google Play Store app downloads, and Google Assistant voice remotes.
Full subscription accounts to top global video streaming giants integrated cleanly into your unified monthly subscription bill.
